headline: Legacy Law Offices acts on Nexa Defence IPO
sum: Nexa Defence (I) Limited has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) on the Bombay Stock Exchange SME (BSE SME) platform on September 22, 2026 for a book-built offer for a fresh issue of 33,64,000 shares, with an offer size of ₹30.2…
detail: Nexa Defence (I) Limited has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) on the Bombay Stock Exchange SME (BSE SME) platform on September 22, 2026 for a book-built offer for a fresh issue of 33,64,000 shares, with an offer size of ₹30.2 crore+. Legacy Law Offices advised Nexa Defence and the Book Running Lead Manager on this SME IPO. The transaction team comprised of Naman Anand (Counsel), and Associates Meghna Shukla, Pavitra Balgi, and Trainee Associate Priyanshu Raghav. Surbhi Narang (Partner) provided strategic inputs.
